svg.title: The same daily pipeline now recovers missed deliveries
svg.desc: The daily job reads the tracking table, finds pending and new dates, checks Walmart's status for each date, requests each available delivery by feed date, downloads the files to landing, loads Bronze with Auto Loader, and marks the delivery complete only after all its files load. No second pipeline or schedule is needed.
svg.text: The fix: same pipeline, smarter daily logic
load every missing available delivery, not just the latest one
Example scenario with made-up dates. One delivery per day is assumed for illustration.
Parameter names are ours, not Walmart's. Status check and feed-date request are from my notes, not checked against the API reference.

g.text: Same job, same schedule, new logic
Instead of asking only for the latest delivery, the daily run now works through every pending date.
5 Oct is pending, so the job checks its status, requests it by feed date, downloads the files, loads Bronze, then marks it complete.
6 Oct is pending, so the job checks its status, requests it by feed date, downloads the files, loads Bronze, then marks it complete.
So it is never silent again
The gap is closed: 4, 5, 6 and 7 October are all complete.
Daily incremental now means: load every missing available delivery. Manual recovery is the same job run with a date range.
